info.name: BookingEngineApi Account notes Identity documents API

items.docs: Returns all identity documents for the specified customers, with additional filtering options available. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Deletes specified identity documents. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Deletes all identity documents for the specified customers. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Updates specified identity documents. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Adds identity documents. This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
